style: 3D animation, furry realism, slapstick comedy, deadpan
motion_rule: hero rides a cargo belt across frame each beat; camera always moving, shot size changes every beat; something fills the lens each beat; one action per beat; motion across frame or at the lens; never wider than medium, his head over a third of frame
character: a spotted hyena, shaggy, no clothes, upright on hind legs, the same throughout, jaw opens on each syllable
second_characters: clerk ground squirrels streaming the other way on a second belt, packed tight, a shoulder from the lens; ONE walking beaver clerk with a metal hole punch
props: a bulging sack of coins in his paws; coins pouring from his punched palm; tin bowls held by the squirrels; a hole punch in the beaver's paw; crates packing the passage
prop_continuity: the sack deflates to empty by beat 5, then swings limp from his wrist; the hole in his left palm opens in beat 3, another in beat 7, both stay lit; the bowls are empty in beat 2, full from beat 6
environment: a bright payout hall at noon, glass roof, crates and shelving packed tight, two cargo belts running across frame in opposite directions

light_events.event: columns of noon daylight from the glass roof strobe over him, glints off the coins; from 5.60 a shaft goes through the holes in his palm

audio.delivery: male, low, dry, flat, 4 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: po-lu-CHIL zar-PLA-tu na RU-ki, RU-ki o-ka-ZA-lis dy-RYA-vy-ye, DY-ry SVER-lyat pri NAY-me. Latin hints are never voiced aloud
audio.pacing: first word on frame one, last word ends by 7.20, then hall noise
audio.lip_sync: accurate, jaw opens on every syllable
sfx: belt rumble, roller clatter, coins on tin

timeline.action: he rides the belt across frame at the lens with the bulging sack in both paws, baring his teeth over it; two squirrels rush past his shoulder
he swings the sack over his head and rides on; four squirrels tear past the other way, empty bowls thrust at his paws, one bowl covering the lower lens

he holds out his left palm and his jaw clacks at the snap, not stopping; the walking beaver strides past, not looking, punches a hole through the palm and walks out; the palm and the first coins fill the lens
he swings the sack across the lens and rides on, coins pouring past him; three squirrels slide bowls under the stream; coins ricochet off the tin at the lens
he strides forward along the belt, outrunning his load, the sack deflating in his paw; squirrels with full bowls rush past his shoulder
punchline: he dives muzzle first into the lens and sweeps the punched palm across frame, daylight through the hole; a squirrel rides past behind his head with a full bowl
he sweeps the palm at the lens and bares his teeth again at it; the beaver rides past and calmly punches a second hole at the lens, both on the move
he rides on and sweeps the punched palm across frame, daylight through both holes, head jerking around; squirrels with full bowls press past

must_appear: the bulging sack at 0.00; the hole punch at his palm in beat 3; coins pouring from 3.30; muzzle into the lens and a glowing hole at 5.60-7.20; bowls full at 8.40; every line spoken by 7.20
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, digits, an inscription, garbled words, Latin letters, a static camera, a still background, an empty hall, standing in place, an establishing shot, walking away from the lens, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, English speech, two hyenas in frame, clerks carrying the hyena, floating objects, blood on his paws, a repeated word
